chs.name: Drunken Master
chs.description: 姿态。 For 72...90 seconds, your movement and attack speeds are increased by 10...15%. If you are drunk while activating this skill, your movement and attack speeds are increased by 25...33% instead.
chs.concise: 姿态。 (72...90 seconds.) You move and attack 10...15% faster if you are not drunk. You move and attack 25...33% faster if you are drunk.

cht.name: 酒醉大師
cht.description: 態勢： 持續 72...90 秒，移動及攻擊速度加快 10...15% 。若在酒醉狀態發動此技能，移動及攻擊速度則為加快 25...33% 。
cht.concise: 態勢： For 72...90 seconds, your movement and attack speeds are increased by 10...15%. If you are drunk while activating this Skill, your movement and attack speeds are increased by 25...33% instead.

de.name: Betrunkener Meister
de.description: Haltung. 72...90 Sekunde[n] lang sind Eure Bewegungs- und Angriffsgeschwindigkeit um 10...15% erhöht. Wenn Ihr beim Aktivieren dieser Fertigkeit betrunken seid, sind Eure Bewegungs- und Angriffsgeschwindigkeit stattdessen um 25...33% erhöht.
de.concise: Haltung. 72...90 Sekunde[n]: Eure Bewegungs- und Angriffsgeschwindigkeit ist um 10...15% erhöht, falls Ihr nicht betrunken seid. Eure Bewegungs- und Angriffsgeschwindigkeit ist um 25...33% erhöht, falls Ihr betrunken seid.

de-guildwiki.name: Betrunkener Meister
de-guildwiki.description: 72...90 Sekunden lang ist Eure Bewegungsgeschwindigkeit um 10...15% erhöht und der Abstand zwischen Euren Angriffen sinkt um 10...15%. Wenn Ihr beim Aktivieren dieser Fertigkeit betrunken seid, verändern sich diese Werte stattdessen um 25...33%.
de-guildwiki.concise: 72...90 Sekunden: Eure Bewegungs- und Angriffsgeschwindigkeit ist um 10...15% erhöht, falls ihr nicht betrunken seid. Eure Bewegungs- und Angriffsgeschwindigkeit ist um 25...33%. erhöht, falls ihr betrunken seid.

en.name: Drunken Master
en.description: Stance. For 72...90 seconds, your movement and attack speeds are increased by 10...15%. If you are drunk while activating this skill, your movement and attack speeds are increased by 25...33% instead.
en.concise: Stance. (72...90 seconds.) You move and attack 10...15% faster if you are not drunk. You move and attack 25...33% faster if you are drunk.

en-gww.name: Drunken Master
en-gww.description: For 72...90 seconds, your movement and attack speeds are increased by 10...15%. If you are drunk while activating this skill, your movement and attack speeds are increased by 25...33% instead.
en-gww.concise: (72...90 seconds.) You move and attack 10...15% faster if you are not drunk. You move and attack 25...33% faster if you are drunk.

es.name: Maestro borracho
es.description: Actitud. Durante 72...90 segundos, te mueves y atacas un 10...15% más deprisa. Si estás borracho mientras activas esta habilidad, te moverás y atacarás un 25...33% más deprisa.
es.concise: Actitud. (72...90 segundos). Te mueves y atacas un 10...15% más rápido si no estás borracho. Te mueves y atacas un 25...33% más rápido si lo estás.

fr.name: Maître ivre
fr.description: Pose de combat. Pendant 72...90 secondes, vos vitesses de mouvement et d'attaque sont augmentées de 10...15%. Si vous êtes ivre lorsque vous activez cette compétence, vos vitesses de mouvement et d'attaque sont augmentées de 25...33%.
fr.concise: Pose de combat. (72...90 secondes.) Vous attaquez et vous déplacez 10...15% plus vite si vous n'êtes pas ivre. Vous attaquez et vous déplacez 25...33% plus vite si vous êtes ivre.

fr-gwiki.name: Maître ivre
fr-gwiki.description: Pendant 72...90 secondes, vos vitesses de mouvement et d'attaque sont augmentées de 10...15%. Si vous êtes ivre lorsque vous activez cette compétence, vos vitesses de mouvement et d'attaque sont augmentées de 25...33%

it.name: Maestro Ubriaco
it.description: Posizione. Per 72...90 secondo[i], la velocità dei tuoi movimenti e attacchi aumenta del 10...15%. Se attivi quest'abilità mentre sei in stato di ebbrezza la velocità dei tuoi movimenti e attacchi aumenta invece di un 25...33%.
it.concise: Posizione. (Secondi: 72...90) Incremento velocità tuoi movimenti e attacchi se non sei in stato d'ebbrezza: 10...15%. Incremento velocità tuoi movimenti e attacchi se sei in stato d'ebbrezza: 25...33%.

jp.name: ドランクン マスター
jp.description: スタンス： 72...90 秒間、移動および攻撃速度が 10...15% 増加します。このスキルの発動時に飲酒している場合、移動および攻撃速度は 25...33% の増加になります。
jp.concise: スタンス： (72...90 秒) 飲酒中ではない場合、移動および攻撃速度が 10...15% 増加します。飲酒中の場合、移動および攻撃速度が 25...33% 増加します。

kr.name: 만취한 달인
kr.description: 자세. 72...90초 동안 이동 속도와 공격 속도가 10...15%, 만약 스킬을 시전할 때 술에 취한 상태이면 이동 속도와 공격 속도가 25...33% 빨라집니다.
kr.concise: 자세. (72...90초) 술 취한 상태가 아니면 이동 속도와 공격 속도가 10...15% 빨라지고, 술 취한 상태면 이동 속도와 공격 속도가 25...33% 빨라집니다.

pl.name: Pijacki Mistrz
pl.description: Postawa. Przez 72...90 sek. poruszasz się i atakujesz o 10...15% szybciej. Z kolei jeżeli jesteś pijany aktywując tą umiejętność, to poruszasz się i atakujesz o 25...33% szybciej.
pl.concise: Postawa. (72...90 sek.) Poruszasz się i atakujesz o 10...15% szybciej, jeżeli nie jesteś pijany. Poruszasz się i atakujesz o 25...33% szybciej, jeżeli jesteś pijany.

ru.name: Drunken Master
ru.description: Стойка. В течение 72...90 сек скорость вашего движения и атаки увеличивается на 10...15%. Если вы были пьяны при использовании этого умения, вместо этого вы будете двигаться и атаковать на 25...33% быстрее.
ru.concise: Стойка. (72...90 сек) Вы двигаетесь и атакуете на 10...15% быстрее, если вы не пьяны. Вы двигаетесь и атакуете на 25...33% быстрее, если вы пьяны.

bork.name: Droonkee Maester
bork.description: Stunce-a. Fur 72...90 secunds, yuoor mufement und aettaeck speeds aere-a increaesed by 10...15%. Iff yuoo aere-a droonk vheele-a aecteefaeteeng thees skeell, yuoor mufement und aettaeck speeds aere-a increaesed by 25...33% insteaed.
bork.concise: Stunce-a. (72...90 secunds.) Yuoo mufe-a und aettaeck 10...15% faester iff yuoo aere-a nut droonk. Yuoo mufe-a und aettaeck 25...33% faester iff yuoo aere-a droonk.
